data.title: Atlantic pace, neighbourhood logic, and honest hotel picks
data.intro: Both Lisbon and Porto reward slow mornings and long evenings. These packages are built around that rhythm.

data.title: Alfama rooftops and river club check-in
data.summary: A riverside hotel, tram pass, and a private food-led walk through Alfama and Mouraria. Breakfast included.

data.title: Cellar tastings and a long afternoon across the Douro
data.summary: A long weekend anchored by Gaia cellar visits, a market lunch, and a riverside stay near Ribeira.

data.quote: Porto was the biggest surprise of the trip. We planned two nights and extended to four. The cellar tour across the bridge was the best afternoon of the whole holiday.
